label: DELETE /monitor
description: DELETE /monitor with a body of ids → the entries that were removed, in the order asked. Every deletion is issued at once, paced by the connection's throttle, and the answer leaves only after the last one settled; one entry that does not exist refuses the whole request as missing (404). Employees holding the recorder role only: 401 as anonymous without a token or as invalid_credential with a bad one, 403 as forbidden for a customer or an employee without the role.
